Status.note: The EIA-860M table for September 2026 lists this unit as operating. Row: Plant 2966, generator 4, status operating, nameplate 53.0 MW, operating year 1975, planned retirement 2030. This confirms the status; it does not change it.

Planned retire.note: The 2026 integrated resource plan refresh from PSO (Public Service Company of Oklahoma) lists Weleetka units 4 and 5 for retirement in 2030, and the EIA-860M table for September 2026 gives planned retirement year 2030. This matches the tracker. No new scheduled event is needed. The plan is at https://www.psoklahoma.com/lib/docs/community/projects/PSO_2026_IRP_Refresh_Final_Report.pdf.

units.notes: The EIA table for September 2026 shows unit 4 operating with retirement planned for 2030, and the PSO plan agrees. I found no document that states a Backup Power value. The unit is a grid gas turbine and no source says it is backup power.
